+package server
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"log"
+	"net/http"
+
+	qrcode "github.com/skip2/go-qrcode"
+
+	"git.aisoftwarefactory.world/linkshort2/linkshort2/internal/store"
+)
+
+// statsDays is the window of days the stats endpoint reports, today included.
+const statsDays = 30
+
+// stats answers the clicks per UTC day of the last statsDays days for the
+// slug as a JSON array of {date, count}, oldest day first, to the link's
+// owner only: another user's slug, or no slug at all, answers 404.
+func (s *Server) stats(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, user *store.User) {
+	slug := r.PathValue("slug")
+	if !s.ownsSlug(r, user, slug) {
+		http.NotFound(w, r)
+		return
+	}
+	stats, err := s.store.GetClickStats(r.Context(), slug, statsDays)
+	if err != nil {
+		switch {
+		case errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound):
+			http.NotFound(w, r)
+		case errors.Is(err, store.ErrInvalid):
+			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid slug")
+		default:
+			log.Printf("server: stats: %v", err)
+			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "try again later")
+		}
+		return
+	}
+	type dayCount struct {
+		Date  string `json:"date"`
+		Count int64  `json:"count"`
+	}
+	out := make([]dayCount, len(stats))
+	for i, st := range stats {
+		out[i] = dayCount{Date: st.Day, Count: st.Clicks}
+	}
+	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
+}
+
+// qr answers a PNG of the short URL of the slug, to the link's owner only:
+// another user's slug, or no slug at all, answers 404.
+func (s *Server) qr(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, user *store.User) {
+	slug := r.PathValue("slug")
+	link, err := s.store.GetLinkBySlug(r.Context(), slug)
+	if err != nil {
+		switch {
+		case errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound):
+			http.NotFound(w, r)
+		default:
+			log.Printf("server: qr link: %v", err)
+			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "try again later")
+		}
+		return
+	}
+	if link.UserID != user.ID {
+		// Another user's link is no one's link here.
+		http.NotFound(w, r)
+		return
+	}
+	png, err := qrcode.Encode(shortURL(r, link.Slug), qrcode.Medium, 256)
+	if err != nil {
+		log.Printf("server: qr encode: %v", err)
+		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "try again later")
+		return
+	}
+	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "image/png")
+	// #nosec G705 -- the body is a PNG the library encoded, not HTML; no
+	// browser renders it as a document.
+	_, _ = w.Write(png)
+}
+
+// ownsSlug reports whether the user holds a link of the slug. A store error
+// that is not ErrNotFound counts as "not owned": the client sees 404 and the
+// fault goes to the log, never into the answer.
+func (s *Server) ownsSlug(r *http.Request, user *store.User, slug string) bool {
+	link, err := s.store.GetLinkBySlug(r.Context(), slug)
+	switch {
+	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound):
+		return false
+	case err != nil:
+		log.Printf("server: stats link: %v", err)
+		return false
+	}
+	return link.UserID == user.ID
+}
+
+// shortURL is the public address a click of the link comes to: the scheme,
+// host and port this request arrived at, with the slug under /.
+func shortURL(r *http.Request, slug string) string {
+	scheme := "http"
+	if r.TLS != nil {
+		scheme = "https"
+	}
+	return scheme + "://" + r.Host + "/" + slug
+}
